result.summary: The interface presents legibility issues on banners and text truncation in lists.

issues.description: Banner text contrast is too low for readability, specifically white text on light green.
issues.suggestion: Apply a higher contrast color palette to the promotional card text.

issues.description: Restaurant names overflow their containers, leading to text truncation in the carousel.
issues.suggestion: Adjust card width or allow multi-line text to prevent clipping names.

issues.description: Generic graphics act as suboptimal placeholders instead of high-quality food photography.
issues.suggestion: Replace vector icons with real food images to enhance professional appeal.
